details:
Q1: What does "it" refer to, meaning which part of the repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific reusable workflow (clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, orchestrate, validate, update_workflows). Name it in your /answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script or helper under `scripts/`. Name the file in your /answer.
C. Documentation (README.md, docs/, agents.d fragments).
D. Something else. Describe it in your /answer.
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure you saw. Paste the run URL, log excerpt or wrong behaviour in your /answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Lower cost or runtime (fewer API calls, runner jobs or tokens).
C. Make it more reliable (fewer flaky failures, better retry or self-heal).
D. Make it clearer for users or operators (docs, log messages, alerts).
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete, checkable outcome you state in your /answer, such as "run X no longer fails with Y" or "workflow Z uses N fewer jobs per PR". (RECOMMENDED)
B. Planning proposes a small, surgical improvement in the area you chose in Q1, and you accept or reject it when you approve the plan.
